meta.name: etetoolkit
meta.description: Analyze, manipulate, compare, annotate, and visualize phylogenetic or other hierarchical trees with ETE 4. Use for Newick/Nexus tree I/O, topology edits and pattern matching, Robinson-Foulds comparisons, gene-tree evolutionary events and reconciliation, NCBI/GTDB taxonomy, SmartView exploration, and publication rendering. Do not use it to infer trees from raw sequences; align sequences and infer a tree first.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析、比较与注释进化树
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果处理系统发育数据并需要比较树结构。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze, compare, and annotate phylogenetic trees.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with phylogenetic data and need to compare tree topologies.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 可以用 ETE 4 读取、修改和比较进化树(如 Newick/NHX 格式),检测基因树的复制/分化事件,获取 NCBI 分类信息,并把树渲染成 PDF/SVG 图片。
howto.when: 当你要求读写 Newick/Nexus 树、比较树拓扑、检测进化事件等时触发。不会用于从原始序列直接推断树。

say.text: 读取 tree.nw,输出叶子数和节点数。
say.note: Claude 会加载树并打印统计信息。

say.text: 把 gene_tree.nw 按物种拆出直系同源组,并保存为 PDF。
say.note: 会检测复制/分化事件并输出直系同源树。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use ETE 4 to read, edit and compare phylogenetic trees (e.g., Newick/NHX), detect duplication/speciation events in gene trees, fetch NCBI taxonomy, and render trees to PDF/SVG.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to read/write Newick/Nexus trees, compare tree topologies, detect evolutionary events, etc. Not used for inferring trees from raw sequences.

say_en.text: Read tree.nw and print the number of leaves and total nodes.
say_en.note: Claude loads the tree and prints stats.

say_en.text: Compare tree1.nw and tree2.nw and give the Robinson-Foulds distance.
say_en.note: Computes normalized RF distance and lists differences.

say_en.text: Split gene_tree.nw into ortholog groups by species and save as PDF.
say_en.note: Detects duplication/speciation events and outputs ortholog trees.
